notes: Ban 1.6.0: MCP (dieu khien Revit bang AI) len 82 tool. Moi: doc ban ve CAD (DWG/DXF: layer, text, block, dim) va kiem tra model Revit ve dung ban ve chua - bao cau kien lech bao nhieu mm, thieu, sai be day (doc text DWG can may co AutoCAD hoac dung file DXF). Tao kich thuoc (project + family, gan label vao parameter), dung family revolve/sweep/blend, tiet dien tron, gan vat lieu. bim_run_code chay tren Revit 2024-2027, co hop thoai xin phep nguoi dung. Quan ly document, job nen, tu chon cong khi mo nhieu Revit. Sua 15 form bi che/cat chu. Dong Revit truoc khi cai.
